t: Signature Micro-DDS: What Micro-DDS Is: DDS for Small Things
title: Signature Micro-DDS: What Micro-DDS Is: DDS for Small Things
description: The Signature counterpart is the SigPulse bus, Manon's original constrained-messaging design. SigPulse mirrors the client/agent/data-space architecture but every topic carries a static schedule slot — the bus is time-triggered as well as event-driven. The Signature design proves the schedule fits before deployment: no slot, no publish.

t: Signature Micro-DDS: XRCE-DDS: The Client/Agent Pattern
title: Signature Micro-DDS: XRCE-DDS: The Client/Agent Pattern
description: SigPulse's pattern is the herald and the steward: the herald on the device speaks the compact wire protocol; the steward on the host holds the schedule and the QoS state. The Signature design makes the steward attest the schedule — the device can verify its slot allocation cryptographically.
